responsibility: This generated machine-description fragment supplies the C6X multiplication-family RTL patterns, including scalar, widening, mixed signedness, vector, dot-product, rotate/bit-reverse, average, and fractional multiply instructions executed on the M units. In addition to normal define_insn patterns used during instruction selection, it contains paired *_real variants wrapped in UNSPEC_REAL_MULT for modulo scheduling and software-pipelining support, with detailed unit, type, cross-path, and operand-pattern attributes that feed the scheduler and final assembly output.
